Important: IRS tax form 5498-SA for your health savings account (HSA)
Dear ANDREW:
The enclosed IRS tax form 5498-SA shows your 2024 contributions to your Optum Bank health savings account (HSA). Please use this information to fill out IRS tax form 8889 which is what you’ll need to submit your taxes. To
access IRS tax form 8889 log in at irs.gov and navigate to Forms and Publications.
Here’s what you need to know:
Box 2 shows your total contributions made for 2024 including those made in 2024 for 2023, if applicable.
You have until the tax filing deadline of this year to submit contributions for 2024. If you make any contributions in 2025 before the tax deadline for 2024 you will receive an updated 5498-SA in May.
To get your total contributions for 2024 add Box 2 plus Box 3. Please note you if you made any contributions in 2024 for 2023 you need to review your updated 5498 for 2023 and subtract that Box 3.
The Fair Market Value consists of your HSA cash balance and any investment balance as of 12/31/2024
If you had a reportable distribution for 2024, you’ll also get tax form 1099-SA. If you did not use (no distributions) your HSA in 2024 you will not get a 1099-SA.
Ready to say goodbye to printed forms? Log in to your account to access your HSA, click "Accounts" from menu bar, select "Account Management" and update your Communications preference to "Online."
Questions? Please log in at www.optumbank.com to access your HSA or call 1-866-234-8913.
